description: Three-phase DIN rail network analyzer (80 A direct, 1/5 A CT or Rogowski inputs), RS485 Modbus RTU/ASCII or Ethernet Modbus TCP
source: Algodue, "UPM209 user manual (Bedienungsanleitung)" Ed2111, part "MODBUS Communication Protocol", section 4

sources.title: UPM209 Bedienungsanleitung (user manual)
sources.note: MODBUS communication protocol part (in English), section 4

notes: Algodue UPM209 network analyzer; demand, max, harmonic and some other values need the ENH version. PT settings apply to the 1/5 A CT and Rogowski versions only.
FC03 or FC04 reads, FC10 writes; big endian, high word first. Up to 127 registers per read in RTU (256 bytes in TCP), up to 29 registers per write in RTU and 1 in TCP.
Each value is also published as an integer from 0x0000 (mV, mA, mW, 0.1 Wh…); this map uses the IEEE float copies from 0x1000 in V, A, W, var, VA and Wh.
Changing the CT or PT ratio, wiring or current full scale resets min/max, demand, energy counters, digital outputs and recordings.
Digital output, recording and parameter-code settings are in the manual and not in this map.
